summary: Equinox Gold Corp., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a positive Record of Decision (ROD) from the U.S. Bureau of Land Management for its South Railroad gold project in Nevada. The milestone completes federal permitting under NEPA and allows early construction to begin. The project, an open-pit heap leach mine, is expected to produce 130,000 ounces of gold annually over its first five years, with initial capital costs estimated at $395 million. This is an operational and permitting update, not a corporate special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or transaction mechanics are involved. Watch for construction milestones and production timeline adherence.
